notes.title: Play the AVGN 8-bit Demo!
notes.content:
[h3]The demo for Angry Video Game Nerd 8-bit is now available!
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455685/8a20ed5b4154fbb0079357b443890e585a0301a7.gif[/img]

Unleash your ULTIMATE NERD RAGE on TWO levels that pit you against ghoulish ghouls, skeleton robots, and more! Collect upgrades to improve your weapon, pick up helpful items like health or armor, and take down a rage-inducing boss waiting at the end of each level!

Get a taste of the full AVGN 8-bit experience with the new demo, available to play now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455685/9e6636f4976c5eadf4869ee915b53a15f20f095f.png[/img]
